title: Attempts to discredit Lazar's Los Alamos and S4 employment
place_text: Los Alamos, New Mexico; S4, Area 51, Nevada

tellings.quote: they tried to say that he never worked at Los Alamos, but that's been confirmed. And then they tried to say that he was never at Area S4 or Area 51 site 4, but he was there and he knew it.

related.note: Both are about whether Lazar really worked at Los Alamos and S4. The story's teller says his work there was confirmed; Davis says he was only a radiation badge monitor for a logistics contractor and never went to Area 51.

plain: Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on alien craft in the 1980s at S4, a hidden site near Area 51, the secret Air Force test base in Nevada, was the target of efforts to show he had never held those jobs. The comedian and podcast host Joe Rogan tells Michels this, drawing on Lazar and on the Las Vegas journalist George Knapp: 'they tried to say that he never worked at Los Alamos, but that's been confirmed,' and then that he was never at S4, 'but he was there and he knew it.' If Rogan is right, the attacks on Lazar's work record failed, and his account of the site stands on firmer ground.
